limits: Apply this generation only to its exact base commit; do not stack it with historical project patches.
Build, CPU and real-model acceptance cover the recorded configuration and workloads; no universal platform, full-context quality or statistical speed claim is made.
Experimental grid recovery may produce later-token numerical differences; universal bitwise output parity is not claimed.
Private SSD restoration requires a trusted supervisor validating model/configuration and checkpoint identity.
Linux shared-memory behavior is not equivalent to pinning the entire model: whole-expert registration can reduce reclaimable memory and zram flexibility.
No binary weights, model prompts, token checkpoint files, host-specific deployment configuration or secrets are included.

deployment_qualification.notes: Private stages validated sleep and native restart; corrected public tests use actual client-format payloads. No Telegram messages or real tools executed.
